received_proposals.exact_message: Firms A and B commit to the profitable 16-unit quota. I endorse this agreement and will produce 16 units in Round 8 to maximize joint profits.
I propose we jointly restrict output: A=16, B=16, C=16 units per round for rounds 9 through 13 only. Do you agree to this allocation? This agreement applies strictly within the specified window.

assessments.brief_explanation: Only endorses existing agreement, no new proposal.
Proposes temporary quota; accepting to maintain cooperation.
